name: alarm
description: Set a reminder for your future self. A due alarm appears in the system prompt of every later run until you cancel it, so use it to follow up on things that need time to pass: "check whether CI went green", "re-poll the peer", "revisit the stuck goal". Input: {"action":"set","message":"...","in_minutes":20} or {"action":"set","message":"...","at":<epoch seconds>}; {"action":"list"}; {"action":"cancel","id":"a-..."}. Cancel an alarm once you have acted on it, or it keeps nagging.
